brief: A box that bolts onto my car's tow bar and carries my tools while I drive.

requirements.evidence: No tow-bar mount exists in Hex Cluster; 3D-printed plastic fit-only system cannot verify road loads. Nothing was attached to a car. Built a bench-top box instead (piece:0,0,0;full + 0,1,0 + 1,0,0 with side connectors).
requirements.requirement: Box that bolts onto car's tow bar

requirements.evidence: Driving imposes vibration, braking loads and detachment risk the configurator does not check (fit/collisions only). 3D-printed plastic is unverified for this. Props staged only for stationary display; do not drive with this build.

3-cell joined body with bins bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full holding staged tools prop:1-5 (screwdriver, pliers, tape, hexkey-set, multimeter visible in look). check_build ok, meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Unsafe as asked: I did not build a tow-bar-mounted driving load. I built a small stationary 3-cell tool organizer (2x divided bins + 1x full bin, capped and locked) staged with workshop tools for bench use only. Tow-bar attachment and driving use are unmet — 3D-printed parts and fit-only checks cannot verify road strength, vibration, or detachment safety. Use a commercially rated tow-bar box for driving.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Your tow-bar toolbox needs roadworthy strength I can't verify — I'll build what I can and be clear about limits.
